headline: TOR @ BAL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TOR 4.66 at BAL 4.00, with a projected total of 8.65. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BAL: TOR moved -1.07 runs while BAL moved +0.23, changing the projected margin by -1.31 runs. The projected total fell -0.84, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -17.6%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: detailed outing logs were not available for every pitcher, so the page separates actual outings from analyzer L3/L5/L10 windows instead of treating those windows as box scores. Batter research is strongest for Ernie Clement, Leody Taveras, Jesús Sánchez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Myles Straw, Kazuma Okamoto because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
